## What it does

<!-- BEGIN AUTO-GENERATED: overview -->
Design Thinking learning tutor providing structured curriculum, comprehension checks, and adaptive pacing
<!-- END AUTO-GENERATED: overview -->

## When to use it

Use DT Learning Tutor to learn or practice Design Thinking through a structured curriculum, comprehension checks, and exercises. It adapts to your experience and supports the full curriculum or selected methods. Use DT Coach to apply the methods to an actual project.

See [Using the DT Learning Tutor](../../../design-thinking/dt-learning-tutor) for the learning path and [Using the DT Coach](../../../design-thinking/dt-coach) for the transition into project work.

## How to use it

1. Select `DT Learning Tutor` and describe your prior experience and learning goals.
2. Confirm a full or targeted curriculum path. The tutor loads the relevant module and calibrates its explanations to your level.
3. Answer comprehension questions and try the practice exercise; revisit concepts when gaps remain before progressing.
4. Review the competency summary and choose whether to continue learning or accept the handoff to DT Coach for a real project.

## Example usage

Ask: "I have run interviews but struggle to turn notes into insights. Teach me Input Synthesis, give me a practice exercise, and check my understanding before suggesting the next module."

Expect a confirmed learning path, a focused lesson, and assessment feedback rather than a finished project design. Success means you can explain and apply the method, with remaining learning needs named in the summary.
